The '''Shaldania Parade''' was the traditional opening to the [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]], featuring floats, bands and a procession of military regiments from all over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Imperial Palace Guard]] took part in the parade as the first unit to march.<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets 8" />
